request.prompt:

- 85: Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles
    contains 853952: Lamps; light-emitting diode (LED) light sources, light-emitting diode (LED) lamps
    contains 853951: Lamps; light-emitting diode (LED) light sources, light-emitting diode (LED) modules
    contains 853941: Lamps; arc-lamps
    contains 853932: Lamps; discharge, (excluding ultra-violet), mercury or sodium vapour lamps, metal halide lamps
    contains 853949: Lamps; ultra-violet or infra-red lamps, (excluding arc-lamps)
    contains 853922: Lamps; filament, (excluding ultra-violet or infra-red), of a power not exceeding 200W and for a voltage exceeding 100 volts, other than tungsten halogen
    contains 853910: Lamps; sealed beam units

    contains 853921: Lamps; filament, (excluding ultra-violet or infra-red), tungsten halogen
    contains 853931: Lamps; discharge, (excluding ultra-violet), fluorescent, hot cathode

    contains 940521: Luminaires and light fittings; electric, table, desk, bedside or floor-standing, for use solely with light-emitting diode (LED) light sources

data.reason: An electric LED desk luminaire for use solely with LED sources falls under heading 9405 (subheading 940521) in Chapter 94, not the lamp/light source items of Chapter 85, which cover bulbs and portable self-powered lamps.
